name: Kitakouji Wakana
source: One of the three presidents of the Kitakoji Academy Student Association. She is a graceful but law-abiding and disciplined Yamato Nadeshiko. She is the granddaughter of the former chancellor and the current president of the school. She loves the school and its students, and has a strong desire to lead everyone and improve the school.
